name: game-localization
description: Translate and review video game text with localization rules and a starter glossary.

interface.longDescription: Translate and review video game UI, tutorials, dialogue, subtitles, and store text. Apply project-approved terminology, preserve placeholders and tags, and check length limits before delivering import-ready strings. Includes localization rules and a 75-term starter glossary covering 30 languages and locales.
defaultPrompt: Translate these game strings using my project glossary and preserve placeholders.
